plan.expect: With no loaded model on either side, a non-streaming Responses request with previous_response_id reaches inference and creates one failed monitor row before; after it returns unsupported_parameter HTTP 400 before inference and creates zero monitor rows. An otherwise identical request without previous_response_id creates a failed monitor control row on both sides.
limitations: This scene proves request rejection and monitor visibility, not successful model inference or model switching.
plan.launch: Separate source checkouts, npm ci + npm run build on each, identical backend dependency lock in separate venvs, separate Studio homes/cache/auth/ports. Launch production main.app and setup_frontend with uvicorn; no route or monitor mocks.
